title: Soup Servings
description: Calculate the probability of serving soup A first, plus half the probability of serving both A and B at the same time.
pseudocode:
1. if n > 4800 return 1
2. memo = {}
3. function serve(a, b):
4.   if a <= 0 and b <= 0 return 0.5
5.   if a <= 0 return 1
6.   if b <= 0 return 0
7.   if memo[a,b] return memo[a,b]
8.   memo[a,b] = 0.25 * (serve(a-100, b) + serve(a-75, b-25) + serve(a-50, b-50) + serve(a-25, b-75))
9.   return memo[a,b]

steps.note: Check if n is large enough to approximate to 1
Final probability calculation for n=50 returns 0.625
